_about: Anthony Burgess (d. 1664), member of the Westminster Assembly, minister of Sutton Coldfield: Vindiciae Legis, lectures on the Law and the Covenants against the Antinomians (London, 1647; Sion College's order to print is dated 11 June 1646); The True Doctrine of Justification Asserted and Vindicated, thirty lectures at Lawrence Jewry, second edition corrected (London, 1651); Spiritual Refinings, in two parts, the first on grace and assurance (London, 1658); A Treatise of Original Sin (London, 1658); The Scripture Directory for Church Officers and People, on 1 Corinthians 3 (London, 1659); and An Expository Comment on the whole first chapter of 2 Corinthians (London, 1661). Early English Books Online scans of first or early printings; the OCR prints the long s ('ſ') and old type, so expect errors. Named anthony-burgess because lane C's burgess shelf is Thornton W. Burgess. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
